name: yt-mem-ai
description: YouTube AI: ingest, transcribe, embed, search, and summarize/highlight/digest videos. Ships the yt + yt-agent skills, which drive the yt-ai CLI (via uvx).

interface.shortDescription: Ingest, search, and summarize/highlight YouTube videos.
interface.longDescription: Local-first YouTube pipeline: captions→whisper transcription, per-chunk embeddings in LanceDB, semantic search, and skills for summaries, highlights, digests, and cross-video reviews. The yt and yt-agent skills drive the yt-ai CLI (run via uvx — no install).
